Stackurity 0.14.0: what changed

Here is what changed in Stackurity 0.14.0.

Security
- The preference page no longer accepts a token signed for another installation.

Added
- WordPress plugins and themes, with their latest release.
- Sites without a manifest are discovered.
- Vulnerabilities in installed Windows programs.
- and 3 more in the release notes
  https://github.com/stackurity/stackurity/releases/tag/v0.14.0

Changed
- The action plan groups fixes that share a package across hosts.

Fixed
- A scan that timed out no longer marks the host's inventory complete.

Read the full release notes: https://github.com/stackurity/stackurity/releases/tag/v0.14.0
